calculator_engine: function fire(monthly,swr,age,fireAge,ret,inf){const annual=monthly*12;const fireNumber=annual/swr;const yearsToFire=fireAge-age;const inflAdj=fireNumber*Math.pow(1+inf/100,yearsToFire);const r=ret/100/12;const n=yearsToFire*12;const sip=inflAdj*r/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);return{fireNumber,inflAdj,sip,yearsToFire};}
